compile_command: cc -std=c11 -Wall -Wextra -Wpedantic -Werror tests/test_live_players_ui.c -Iinclude $(pkg-config --cflags gtk+-3.0 json-glib-1.0) -Wl,--wrap=radios_media_library_get -Wl,--wrap=radios_player_loader_open -Wl,--wrap=radios_audio_ui_get_snapshot -Wl,--wrap=radios_audio_ui_load_media -Wl,--wrap=radios_audio_ui_play -Wl,--wrap=radios_audio_ui_pause -Wl,--wrap=radios_audio_ui_stop -o build/test_live_players_baseline build/libradios_ui.a build/libradios_playout.a build/libradios_audio.a build/libradios_core.a $(pkg-config --libs gtk+-3.0 json-glib-1.0 libcurl fontconfig libavformat libavcodec libavutil libswresample libavfilter libpulse) -lm
limitations: The executable embeds the existing Release build static archives available before the prompt-7 fixes. Those archives are not claimed to match an exact pristine source revision; RadioS is not a Git repository.
No shared source files were rolled back for baseline testing. The executable was retained while current source changes continued.
The executable contains the initial six test cases. The current test source was subsequently extended to eleven cases; it is not claimed to be identical to the baseline compilation source.

Library lookup, picker and deck transport boundaries are controlled linker wrappers. These tests verify real Broadcast GTK card logic and callback ordering, not decoding or physical PCM output; existing native PCM acceptance tests cover those contracts.
